card.name: Words just before US federal law names
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "the", "of" or "Under" right before the name of a US federal act, like IDEA, No Child Left Behind or the Voting Rights Act. Mostly in education and law web text.

modes.label: Before named acts
modes.description: A linking word such as "the" or "of" that leads straight into the title of a federal law.

modes.label: Law-citing openers
modes.description: "Under" or "of" used to say that a law governs or contains something, ahead of the law's name.
modes.example: Funding for AT should be considered on case by case basis.<< Under>> IDEA, schools are responsible to purchase AT
